dedupe_keys.name: agros permanent gnss station network of serbia rgz

description: AGROS is the network of permanent GNSS stations of the Republic of Serbia, run by the Republic Geodetic Authority under the 2015 law on state survey and cadastre. The authority describes it as basic geodetic infrastructure and the realisation of the geodetic reference frame to European standards, used for surveying, agriculture, construction of infrastructure projects and information technology. The page describes round-the-clock operation of the Trimble Pivot Platform control centre, real-time monitoring of service quality, checks of daily network adjustments and station residuals, the handling of satellite irregularities, and the authority's role as an EUREF Permanent Network local analysis centre processing 60 stations with Bernese software. Network corrections for GPS and GLONASS are offered under FKP, VRS and other network concepts, as RTCM streams. Access is by user account, with services defined in the active tariff package, so the corrections are paid; no open licence is stated. Caveats: the page is in Serbian, lists services, not a station table, and does not state whether archived RINEX data is sold on the page read. Coverage is Serbia. It supports studies of positioning infrastructure, crustal deformation and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are CROPOS of Croatia and ASG-EUPOS of Poland.
